bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Character Error Rate (CER) of automatic speech recognition (ASR) models for male versus female speakers on the FLEURS development set to determine if the male-dominated training data leads to performance disparities.

Identifying domain-specific religious words by comparing relative token frequencies between the religious training data (MMS-lab) and a general domain corpus (Common Crawl), and then measuring the rate at which ASR models over-predict these biased words on a general evaluation dataset.
